about: The marks components morph between (roadmap Q11), one place for every platform: each a list of polylines on a 24-unit grid, and every mark has the same number of lines and points, so any one becomes any other point by point. `node spec/marks.ts` writes sdk/web/src/marks.ts (phase M adds Swift and Kotlin); test/marks.test.ts fails if it drifts or a mark's shape doesn't match the others. Filled marks (play, pause) close their lines.
